name: book-translator-hub
description: Bilingual paragraph-level LLM translation overlay for stock Calibre-Web Automated (CWA). Read CWA through this container's proxy port and translate EPUB chapters in place with a local OpenAI-compatible LLM (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio). Uses your existing CWA login (native session validation); the translation API is never published. Certified profile: Unraid 7.3.2 x86_64, CWA 4.x, local LLM. Before the first start, create the appdata folder for the non-root container user: [code]mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/book-translator-hub/data && chown 101:102 /mnt/user/appdata/book-translator-hub/data && chmod 0700 /mnt/user/appdata/book-translator-hub/data[/code] Put this container on the same custom Docker network as CWA to use the CWA container name, or use CWA's host IP and port. Keep CWA's "Allow Reverse Proxy Authentication" off.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Private translation cache. Must exist before the first start, owned by 101:102 with mode 0700 (see Overview). Never point it at an old v2.1.x data folder.

ports.name: Reader Proxy Port
ports.description: Open CWA through this port (or route your reader domain to it) to get the translation overlay. The API port 8390 stays internal.

variables.name: CWA URL
variables.description: Base URL of your CWA container, e.g. http://calibre-web-automated:8083 (same custom network) or http://192.168.1.10:8083 (host IP).

variables.name: CWA Session Check URL
variables.description: The same CWA base URL followed by /ajax/emailstat, e.g. http://calibre-web-automated:8083/ajax/emailstat. Used to validate the reader's existing CWA login.

variables.name: Public Reader Origin
variables.description: Exact origin readers use in the browser, without a path, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8385 or https://books.example.com.

variables.name: LLM Model
variables.description: Model name served by your local endpoint, exactly as listed by its /v1/models.

variables.name: Local LLM URL
variables.description: Absolute OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000/v1/chat/completions. Use the host IP or a container name, not localhost.

variables.name: Runtime Role
variables.description: Combined API and reader proxy. Do not change.

variables.name: Auth Mode
variables.description: Validates the reader's native CWA session. Do not change.
